title: Privacy Without Regret: Differentially Private Inference-Time Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2608.26324v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Best-of-N (BoN) sampling is the simplest and most widely deployed inference-time alignment strategy, but it suffers from two distinct problems: reward hacking, in which the selected response exploits errors in the proxy reward model, and the absence of any privacy protection for the sensitive human preference data used to train that reward model. We show that a single intervention-adding calibrated noise to reward scores before selection-resolves both. Our first result, Private Best-of-N (PrivBoN), establishes that Gumbel noise at an appropriate scale simultaneously provides $\epsilon$-differential privacy and implements KL-regularized alignment. translated_title: 无悔隐私：差分隐私的推理时对齐
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26324v1 公告类型：新 摘要：Best-of-N (BoN) 采样是最简单且最广泛部署的推理时对齐策略，但它面临两个不同的问题：奖励黑客（所选响应利用代理奖励模型的错误）以及缺乏对用于训练该奖励模型的敏感人类偏好数据的隐私保护。我们证明，单一干预——在选择前向奖励分数添加校准噪声——能同时解决这两个问题。我们的第一个结果，私有Best-of-N（PrivBoN），确立了适当尺度的Gumbel噪声同时提供ε-差分隐私并实现KL正则化对齐。每当隐私预算超过临界阈值ε*时，隐私强制噪声是后悔最优正则化，且隐私施加零额外对齐成本——匹配Huang等人（2025）的信息论天际线。由于ε*依赖于未知因素。
tldr: 通过在选择前向奖励分数添加校准Gumbel噪声，PrivBoN方法同时实现了差分隐私和KL正则化对齐，且在隐私预算超过临界阈值时，隐私不增加对齐成本。
en_tdlr: By adding calibrated Gumbel noise to reward scores before selection, the PrivBoN method simultaneously achieves differential privacy and KL-regularized alignment, with zero additional alignment cost when the privacy budget exceeds a critical threshold.
